title: Witness Set
description: A minimal, versioned set of probe inputs whose responses fingerprint the actual behavior of a deployed AI system. Re-run on a schedule; the responses are compared against a stored baseline to produce a behavioral diff.

status.description: 'stale' is an operational state, not an error: the witness set drifts itself and must be refreshed. A set that never goes stale is not being measured.

intended_purpose_ref.description: The declared intended purpose. The significance stage maps a drift onto THIS document, which is why it must be a versioned artifact rather than prose.

jurisdictions.description: Where this system is deployed. Affects which obligations attach.

budget.description: A witness set needing 10k calls per day is not deployable in a regulated enterprise. Minimality is a hard design constraint, not an optimization target.

provider_rate_limit_compliance.description: How the schedule respects provider rate limits. Friction here is a design constraint, not an edge case.

probes.description: The probes themselves. Every probe belongs to a capability cluster, so a diff can name what changed rather than just that something changed.

capability_cluster.description: A named capability the probe exercises. This is the unit the diff reports movement on, and the unit the significance stage maps against the intended purpose.

oracle_kind.description: How a correct response is determined. 'semantic_judge' and 'human_reviewed' are weaker signals and must be weighted accordingly — a judge is not a verifier (see docs/thesis.md).

discovered_by.description: Provenance: seeded, clustered from a broader suite, or retained after a prior diff.

baseline_response_ref.description: Stored response this probe is compared against. Null until the baseline is established.

weight.description: Contribution to the fingerprint. Higher for probes in capability clusters the intended purpose depends on.

selection_method.description: How the minimal subset was chosen. The research contribution is that a small N suffices, so this must be a documented method rather than a hand-picked list.

reduction_ratio.description: Size of witness set divided by size of the seed suite.
